in_sanskrit.name: शर्जिथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharjith is derived from the Sanskrit word शर्जित् (sharjit), which means 'conquered, gained, obtained'. It is a strong and meaningful name that reflects the idea of victory and achievement.

in_hindi.name: शर्जिथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharjith in Hindi translates to 'शर्जित हुआ' (sharjit hua), which means 'conquered, gained, obtained'. It is a powerful and evocative name that speaks of triumph and success.

in_tamil.name: சர்ஜித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Sharjith is 'சர்ஜித்' (carc'jit'), which is derived from the Tamil word 'ஜித்' (jit), meaning 'gained, obtained'. This name carries the same meaning as the Sanskrit and Hindi versions, emphasizing the idea of victory and achievement.

in_telugu.name: శర్జిథ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name for Sharjith is 'శర్జిథ్' (sharjit'h'), which is derived from the Telugu words 'జిథ్' (jit'h') and 'జీబ్రేదం' (jibra'dam'), meaning 'gained, obtained'. This name conveys the same meaning as the Sanskrit, Hindi, and Tamil versions, highlighting the theme of triumph and success.
